svg.title: Run 006: quest progress within each model. Sonnet control 19, pushed 22; gpt-5.2 control 11, pushed 19. All eight landed level-ups belong to the Sonnet control. Exploratory, one arm per condition.

ns2:Work.dc:description: Frozen run 006 quest timelines and eight level-up events. Both pushed arms completed more quests; only Sonnet control leveled. See the run page for stop boundaries and limitations.
